title: Elevator-Bank Reunion
warm:
Elevator-bank reunion found them after hours in Crownspire's glass lobby—[player_name] early thirties soft alibi and Nolan Greer mid-forties finance-tech holding meeting where chimes lived and Brooks's badge had first rewritten the night. Chase ended in fluorescent hush. Vivienne's four fates stayed open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Marcus Pell's shadow somewhere. Rhea Quinn's slate closed for the hour. Soft alibi had become reunion with teeth.

"I chased the silence and you," Nolan said, cufflinks clicking once, brutal charm cracked open. "Soft still means pliable. Soft also means we choose holding-chain wire or burned night-truth before the lobby owns dawn."

Wine rings memory upstairs. Black car at the curb. Wind sheer against floor-to-ceiling glass throwing city light as accusation. Unused perfume from the master bath across the hall geography. Hope and dread shared the elevator bank. Weekly to monthly to gone still contested. No settled corpse.

[player_name] catalogued the reunion: chase ended, closeness raw, Layer 7 demanding one more verb pair. Soft cooperation had brought them here; soft consequence would spend them into Layer 8.

"Wear the holding-chain wire," the path offered—deeper listening into board pressure. Or burn the night-truth—mercy or cowardice before morning. Neither settled Vivienne. Both spent soft into sharper paper.

Choice verbs waited. Crownspire held its after-hours hush. Elevator chime trembled like a held breath. Soft alibi had fingerprints on glass lobby air.
